excluded.name: University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore
excluded.reason: The local catalogue already contains a draft university with this slug, the same institutional identity, a uet.edu.pk official-source domain, and five campus names. This batch must not replace or update it.

excluded.name: National University of Technology
excluded.reason: Current official admissions and HEC material place the operational university at I-12, Islamabad. NUTECH described its Capital Smart City site as upcoming in December 2025. A 2023 inauguration story uses ambiguous 'main campus' wording. NUST was already selected as the alternative for this batch; NUTECH remains outside the JSON pending a separate focused record review.

excluded.name: Chakwal Campus
excluded.reason: HEC says UET Taxila's Chakwal campus was upgraded to the independent University of Chakwal effective 2020-01-09. A university undergraduate page still lists it; this batch follows the HEC change notice and will not import it as a current UET Taxila campus.

excluded.name: Ahmedpur East Sub-Campus
excluded.reason: IUB's 2024 annual report labels the physical campus proposed; a 2026 university statement counts six operating campuses and omits Ahmedpur East. Older admissions publicity alone does not prove current physical degree teaching.
